question: After reducing \((x^2-4x+4)/(x^2-4)\), what is its value when \(x=4\)? (Write your answer as a fraction in lowest terms.)
solution: The numerator is \((x-2)^2\), and the denominator is \((x-2)(x+2)\). Reducing gives \((x-2)/(x+2)\). When \(x=4\), the value is \(2/6=1/3\).
